target.statement: OmniVerifier 7B (Decoupled) achieves 0.668 overall accuracy on ViVerBench, compared to 0.650 for the base OmniVerifier 7B and 0.661 for joint training.

compute.basis: Training a 7B multimodal verifier with DAPO RL on 16 A800-80G GPUs for 80 steps, plus data construction using GPT-5 and SAM 2.1, is far beyond a laptop's capability.

blockers: No code release (GitHub link likely placeholder)
Requires 16 NVIDIA A800-80G GPUs for training
Training data construction uses GPT-5 and SAM 2.1, not publicly available
ViVerBench dataset may not be publicly downloadable
title: OmniVerifier-M1: Multimodal Meta-Verifier with Explicit Structured Recalibration
